en.text:

 Beneath the darkened lighthouse, the wind of Icelake remains bitterly cold.
 She knocks on doors, bringing warmth to those within.

 After the October 20, 2026 update (UTC+8) – November 30, 2026, 17:00 (server time)
 Prerequisites:
